# AppsFlyer OneLink Smart Script

Version: 2.9.2. JavaScript is copied without modification from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AppsFlyerSDK/appsflyer-onelink-smart-script/main/scripts/onelink-smart-script-v2.9.2.js

SHA-256: `c52094824bd16b8c4109e27dd8ed32a5caa775af2e05a850ffadffb6b2754021`

The upstream copyright/license notices are retained in the script. The download
integration loads this file only for explicit Google attribution context. Stock
Smart Script stores incoming parameters and referrer information in localStorage.
We do not call its optional impression API or QR renderer.

To upgrade, review upstream changes and storage/network behavior, replace the
unmodified file, update its path and checksum test, and rerun attribution QA.
